children: Consumer sector earnings growth is likely to be driven by margin recovery rather than higher sales, says Siddhartha Khemka, Head of Research, Wealth Management, Motilal Oswal Financial Services. Easing input costs and improving rural demand could support profitability in H2FY27. Titan, Marico and Radico Khaitan are among his preferred consumer stocks. In IT, he sees opportunities in HCLTech, Tech Mahindra and select midcap firms as investor interest in the sector improves. Urban Company's expansion into air conditioners also merits attention. title: IT stocks may regain investor interest as AI trade cools; HCLTech, Tech Mahindra favoured: MOFSL
